what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Tunisia in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10338 asylum seekers from Tunisia.
Italy hosts the largest share, 59.8%, followed by Germany, Canada and Brazil.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tunisia with AQIM and JAK-T from 2013 to 2015, and with the Islamic State group in 2016.
The fact pack does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew in recent years.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 366 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 11415, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Tunisia are counted separately.
